<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/background_color" tools:context=".ui.stats.StatsConstructors">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<!-- Constructors Standings Header --> <com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Constructors Championship" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textAlignment="center" android:textSize="@dimen/big_text_card" android:layout_marginBottom="24dp" />
<!-- Standings Table Header --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:layout_marginBottom="16dp" android:paddingHorizontal="8dp">
<com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="POS" android:textColor="@color/grey_inline" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="4" android:text="TEAM" android:textColor="@color/grey_inline" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" />
<com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="2" android:text="PTS" android:textColor="@color/grey_inline" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" android:textAlignment="center" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Constructors RecyclerView --> <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/constructorsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" tools:itemCount="10" tools:listitem="@layout/item_constructor_standing" />
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView>
